title: In-Person Appointments Late-Cancellation Fee Bands by Notice Given
content:
**Band table: the starting amount of the late-cancellation fee an In-Person Appointments visit carries.**

The starting amount of the late-cancellation fee the visit carries follows the notice the cancellation gave:

| Band | Condition | Starting amount |
|---|---|---|
| A | The notice days counted for the late-cancellation fee the visit carries are 8 or more | The visit type's late-cancellation fee less 15.00 dollars |
| B | Those notice days are 5 to 7 | The visit type's late-cancellation fee less 10.00 dollars |
| C | The cancellation was recorded 1 calendar day or less before the scheduled date | The visit type's no-show fee |
| D | Every other case | The visit type's late-cancellation fee |

Band C is read on calendar days: the calendar days from the cancellation date to the scheduled date, the cancellation date not counted. A cancellation recorded on the day before the scheduled date is 1 calendar day before it; one recorded on the scheduled date itself is 0 calendar days before it. Both are in band C.

**Band edges.** 8 notice days counted is band A and 7 is band B; 5 is band B and 4 falls to band C or D; 1 calendar day is band C and 2 calendar days, with fewer than 5 notice days counted, is band D.

**Examples on the fee schedule figures (hypothetical cancellations).**

| Visit type (late-cancellation fee, no-show fee) | Notice days counted | Calendar days before the scheduled date | Band | Starting amount |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Specialist Consultation ($40.00, $75.00) | 9 | 10 | A | $25.00 |
| In-Office Procedure Visit ($75.00, $125.00) | 6 | 13 | B | $65.00 |
| Established Patient Office Visit ($25.00, $50.00) | 1 | 1 | C | $50.00 |
| Advanced Imaging Appointment ($100.00, $150.00) | 0 | 3 | D | $100.00 |
| Nurse Visit ($15.00, $25.00) | 8 | 8 | A | $0.00 |
